acceptance_criteria: The line-shape implementation follows the full i,m_f sum and distinct Gaussian/erf widths; the validation fixture is explicitly not paper parameters.
Regression implementations use the published 0--1.6 V/cm and 0--9 MHz domains.
The full-QED binding runner fails closed on a named, source-hashed term schema and never guesses missing theory inputs.
All twelve targets are generated from formulas and printed scalar parameters without raw/reference images, author code, or author numeric arrays as computational inputs.
The same-n Stark matrix agrees with exact parabolic eigenvalues, the inter-manifold correction scales as field squared, and all scientific outputs are finite and hash-frozen.
Leading-Dirac and scaled-hyperfine approximations remain explicitly labelled and cannot be promoted to paper exact.
Fail closed until all four author-supplied point-level CSV files exist with exact schemas and recorded hashes.
When inputs are available, re-fit quadratic Stark and linear Doppler models and recompute the 525-point weighted ionization estimate.
Never accept synthetic arrays or digitized source-image pixels as substitutes for author measurement data.
